description: List contacts (customers), paginated, or search them. Search `q` fields: name, email, phone (digits only, no +), updated_since, created_since — e.g. `name:adam email:adam@example.com` (space-separated, all must match). HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/users/.

q.description: Search string, `field:value` pairs separated by spaces.
